definitions.explanation: The grammatical case of the object of a verb; in Japanese grammar, the role marked by を.

examples.japanese: 「⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目的格|もくてきかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{代名詞|だいめいし}→代名詞：11647_daimeishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目的格|もくてきかく}だ。
examples.english: This pronoun is in the objective case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「him」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「he」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目的格|もくてきかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧や{前置詞|ぜんちし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: English 'him' is the objective case of 'he' and comes after verbs and prepositions.

notes:
A term of school grammar, met in explanations of both Japanese and English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目的格|もくてきかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代名詞|だいめいし}→代名詞：11647_daimeishi⟧: an object pronoun
- {目的格|もくてきかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧」: the object-marking ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主格|しゅかく}→主格：33624_shukaku⟧: nominative (subject) case
- ⟦{目的語|もくてきご}→目的語：20479_mokutekigo⟧: the object itself, the word in that role
